A member of the Explorer Society drank too much and may have died in a brawl in The Jolly Axeman tavern in Kazordoon. Go down through one of the tavern's sewers, kill the rat and recover the {item:Explorer Brooch} from the body. You can then hand it to {npc:Mortimer} for 50 gold.

Go to {wiki:The Jolly Axeman Tavern} in **Kazordoon**. The tavern is inside the city, 2 floors below ground level (z=9). In the upper (north) part of the room you can see 4 sewer grates.
The sewer grates in the tavern and the brooch location
Go down and kill the rat

Go down through the sewer grate, kill the {creature:Rat} and take the {item:Explorer Brooch} from the corpse. To leave the sewer, use the {item:Rope} on the spot where you went down: you return to the tavern.

You can trade the brooch with {npc:Mortimer}, at the Explorer Society post in the **east** of **Northport**, for 50 gold. Northport is a small village **northeast of Carlin** (west of Ab'Dendriel): leave Carlin and walk there. Say {key:hi}, {key:brooch} and {key:yes}.
